messages:
maria (Marketing): Quick SEO ops huddle — 6 days until the launch + webinar. Need a compact playbook: keyword mapping, event + FAQ schema, internal links from resource hub, and redirect cleanup for legacy event pages. Assign owners?

alex (SEO): I got keyword mapping and meta. Will produce a CSV with primary intent, secondary keywords, target URL, and suggested title/meta. Top priorities: 'low-latency LLM inference' and 'developer inference platform'.

ben (Content): Ill sync blog copy and webinar blurb to those keywords. Also drafting 4 FAQ Qs for FAQ schema on the landing.

rachel (Growth Ops): Ill own lead routing and UTMs. Need final form fields + hidden utm values. Plan: utm_source=website, utm_medium=blog, utm_campaign=webinar_may2026. HubSpot list name: HS - Webinar May 2026.

josh (Dev): I can implement JSON-LD snippets and the 301 redirects. Confirm canonical strategy: which URL is canonical for search?

alex (SEO): Make the long-form blog the canonical: https://www.redwood.inference.com/blog/launch-low-latency-inference. Webinar landing should canonicalize to that. Blog contains the detailed guide; landing is registration page.

ben (Content): Got it. Blog will be canonical and include registration CTA near the top and in the sidebar.

maria (Marketing): Internal links: add contextual links from /resources, /docs/dedicated, and recent case studies. Also add a banner on /blog index. Keep anchors natural (avoid all exact-match).

alex (SEO): Ill supply an internal-link sheet with recommended anchors and target paths. Example anchors: "low-latency LLM inference" -> /webinars/low-latency-inference-2026; "dedicated inference" -> /docs/dedicated. Limit exact-match anchors to <30% of links.

josh (Dev): For schema Ill produce two small JSON-LD blocks: Event and FAQ. Sample pieces Ill include in the PR (shortened): {"@type":"Event","name":"Low-Latency LLM Inference Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-20T16:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://www.redwood.inference.com/webinars/low-latency-inference-2026"}} and a compact FAQPage block with 3 Qs.

rachel (Growth Ops): Form wiring: hidden fields utm_campaign=webinar_may2026, lead_source=webinar; post to HubSpot endpoint; add Slack webhook to #sales-inbound with payload {name,email,utm_campaign,lead_score}. Ill also create a HubSpot workflow to tag and assign leads to SDR queue.

maria (Marketing): Also add gtag event on success: gtag('event','webinar_reg',{campaign:'webinar_may2026'}). QA required before publish.

alex (SEO): Redirect sweep: two archived event pages still indexed. Recommend 301 -> new landing. Josh, can you add to redirects? Suggested rules (nginx rewrite style): rewrite ^/events/2024-low-latency$ https://www.redwood.inference.com/webinars/low-latency-inference-2026 permanent; rewrite ^/events/inference-deepdive-2024$ https://www.redwood.inference.com/webinars/low-latency-inference-2026 permanent;

josh (Dev): Will add the rules and open a PR. Ill also queue CDN purge for the old paths and the new landing so the 301s propagate fast.

ben (Content): Meta description variants (short): 1) "Join Redwoods webinar to learn low-latency LLM inference techniques: batching, KV caching, and serving best practices." Ill put 3 versions in the sheet.

alex (SEO): Add a structured-data check in CI (lighthouse or schema validator). If it fails on staging, block merge.

josh (Dev): Ill add a lightweight Lighthouse CI job to validate JSON-LD and run a basic rich-results check.

rachel (Growth Ops): Lead routing checklist summary: form -> HubSpot endpoint, hidden utm fields, add lead_source tag, HubSpot workflow assigns SDR, Slack webhook posts to #sales-inbound. Ill share flow IDs in the PR.

maria (Marketing): Owners recap: Alex = keywords + links, Ben = blog + FAQs, Josh = schema + redirects + CI, Rachel = lead routing + tracking. Ill create the launch checklist and schedule a final preflight 24h before the event.

seo-bot: crawl-report: https://seo-report.internal/scan/1767704321 (flags: two archived event pages recommended for 301).

ben (Content): Timeline: draft blog + FAQs by tomorrow AM.

josh (Dev): PR for schema + redirects + CI by EOD today.

rachel (Growth Ops): HubSpot flow + Slack webhook draft by EOD.

maria (Marketing): Perfect. Small PR QA ask: include a check that <link rel=\"canonical\"> on the landing points to the blog. Ping me for review. :thumbsup:
